perspectives.name: discovery-weak-signals
observations: Joby's September 18 autonomy-equipped J208 transcontinental flight remains the newest material primary operational signal located: 3,199 miles with zero onboard safety-pilot control inputs across taxi, takeoff, cruise and landing under remote supervision.
The evidence strengthens dual-use autonomy optionality but remains separate from the core passenger eVTOL certification and scaled manufacturing path.

perspectives.name: expectations-execution
observations: Real-world autonomy maturity is an execution positive for the dual-use platform, but it does not resolve FAA type certification, conforming-aircraft testing, scaled manufacturing or passenger-service economics.
Next decisive commercial evidence remains FAA for-credit certification progress and repeatable production/operations metrics.
